about: The Mississippi River bottoms area covers about 111 square miles of St. Charles County. It is made up of 5 smaller watersheds: Cuivre Island-Mississippi River, Bolter Island-Mississippi River, Marais Temps Clair-Mississippi River, City of Alton-Mississippi River and City of Wood River-Mississippi River. Click one to open it. The land ranges from about 510 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 420 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Cuivre Slough, Belleau Creek, Brick House Slough and Cuivre River. Communities here include West Alton, St. Charles and Portage Des Sioux. All of its water ends up in the Mississippi River.
